Reindeer Cardigan by the Window

Source: 24983.jpg
Cozy, nostalgic, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The reindeer knit pattern and kitten are the focal points.
- Keep only one of sections 79 or 106 if you do not need both.
Try this: Emphasize the reindeer knit pattern and kitten.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy light
brown hair and thin round glasses sits on a window
ledge, holding a small ginger kitten. She wears a
brown and cream reindeer-pattern knit cardigan
over a charcoal turtleneck, with a burgundy plaid
skirt. Her expression is thoughtful. Soft, diffused
window light. Palette of chocolate, cream, and
burgundy. This is a duplicate of section 79.
